notes: conversation benchmark (TEST-699): the same seeded multi-turn conversation per run, history re-sent every turn with the prompt cache on
runs in this order: stock, moe-cache, moe-cache, stock

settings in this record: the stock run; each run carries its own settings, server-log facts, resource peaks, load time and disk reads (runs[]), because the arms can start llama-server with different GPU layers

resource peaks come from the bench-report sampler on llama-server's process tree; VRAM is the server's own share when the OS reports it, else the whole card (runs[].vram_source says which); disk reads are the plugin's own counter or /proc/<pid>/io on Linux, else not recorded
per-turn and per-depth-band numbers are in runs[].turns and runs[].bands; the summary below is the mean over whole runs

protocol.prompt_set: conversation script, seed 42, filled to a 65536-token context
protocol.sampler: greedy, cache_prompt on, chat template of the model, thinking off, answer hint on

runs.disk_read_process_source: Windows ReadTransferCount of llama-server over the run (explicit reads only; memory-mapped page-ins are not counted: a lower bound with --load-mode mmap)
runs.disk_read_source: Windows PhysicalDisk raw Disk Read Bytes of the model's drive D: over the run, whole drive (other programs and mapped page-ins included)
